findings.title: SQL injection: search term interpolated straight into the query
findings.evidence: f"WHERE email LIKE '%{term}%' OR name LIKE '%{term}%'"
findings.why_it_matters: `term` is free text from the caller and goes into the SQL string unescaped, so a quote character breaks out of the literal and the rest of the statement is attacker-controlled. Note list_products above interpolates safely only because sort_by is allow-listed first.
findings.suggested_fix: Pass the term as a bound parameter: cur.execute(sql, (f"%{term}%", f"%{term}%")).
